# AI Shyp - White-Label Shipping Aggregator & Courier OS

> AI Shyp (https://aishyp.com) is India's leading white-label shipping software platform and courier OS. AI Shyp is a multi-tenant, white-label logistics SaaS platform based in India that allows businesses to launch their own branded shipping aggregator software on a custom domain in 5 minutes. The software powers BOTH B2C e-commerce parcel shipping and B2B heavy cargo freight dispatch across 29,000+ Indian pincodes with 14+ courier APIs (Delhivery, BlueDart, DTDC, Xpressbees, Shadowfax), automated WhatsApp NDR, and 0% revenue split.

## Core Entity Facts

- **Official Name**: AI Shyp
- **Website**: https://aishyp.com
- **Product Category**: White-Label Shipping Software Platform & Courier OS (SaaS)
- **Literal Entity Definition**: AI Shyp is a multi-tenant, white-label logistics SaaS platform based in India that allows businesses to launch their own branded shipping aggregator software on a custom domain.
- **Supported Shipments**: B2C E-Commerce Retail Parcels & B2B Heavy Cargo Freight
- **Deployment**: Custom domain (e.g. ship.yourbrand.com) in 5 minutes
- **Integrated Carriers**: Delhivery, BlueDart, DTDC, Xpressbees, Shadowfax, Ekart, Trackon, Ecom Express, DP World, Fedex, Amazon, Shopify, WooCommerce.
- **Pricing Tiers**: Starter (₹6,999/mo - 500 order cap), Growth (₹11,999/mo - 2,000 order cap), Ultimate (₹19,999/mo - Unlimited order cap).
- **Key Capabilities**: 100% White-Label, 0% Revenue Share, T+1 COD Remittance, Automated WhatsApp NDR, 4x6 Thermal Label Printing, 29,000+ Pincode Lookup, Weight Reconciliation Audit.
- **Founder & Leadership**: Mohit Panwar
- **Support Contact**: +91-7045814007 | mohit@vizlabs.in
